note: Local snapshots for the opt-in institution stage. Names and localities never verify identity on their own; only official codes and verified links can support promotion.

level3_hospitals_20260930.csv.source: PhilHealth list of accredited hospitals, as of 2026-09-30 (HOSP_093026.pdf), Level 3 rows
level3_hospitals_20260930.csv.identifier: publication row number of the PDF, stored as 2026-09-30:row-<number>; not a facility code

philhealth_level3_source_20260930.csv.source: transcription of the Level 3 rows of HOSP_093026.pdf with the original row numbers and page numbers
philhealth_level3_source_20260930.csv.use: input of build-level3-hospitals; rebuilds level3_hospitals_20260930.csv byte for byte

unifast_hei_ra10931_20261104.csv.gz.source: UniFAST list of higher education institutions participating under RA 10931, captured 2026-11-04
unifast_hei_ra10931_20261104.csv.gz.scope: participating HEIs only, not all operating HEIs
unifast_hei_ra10931_20261104.csv.gz.identifier: local digest of region and name; not an official HEI code
unifast_hei_ra10931_20261104.csv.gz.ownership_basis: HEI type: SUC and LUC public, Private HEI private, CHED Supervised Institution left for review

deped_schools_national.csv.gz.source: Cleaned extract prepared in project development on 2026-11-04 from a Kaggle-hosted DepEd school masterlist; intermediate schools_town_psgc_clean.csv
deped_schools_national.csv.gz.identifier: DepEd school ID, treated as unverified
deped_schools_national.csv.gz.ownership_basis: six-digit school ID prefix, a hint only (4 private; 1, 2, 3, 5 or 6 public); never promoted without a verified link
deped_schools_national.csv.gz.rights: Original dataset license and redistribution clearance remain unverified. Retained at the repository owner’s direction; local cleaning does not establish redistribution rights.
deped_schools_national.csv.gz.provenance: 30,364 unique school IDs; school_id, school_name and town_psgc retained; Windows-1252 input converted to UTF-8 and gzip-packaged. Exact Kaggle listing, uploader, source snapshot date and license not confirmed.

official_records_quezon_city_seed.csv.source: Quezon City seed of official records: PhilHealth accredited hospital list as of 2025-05-31, DepEd NCR directory of public schools, Quezon City list of government-owned hospitals, CHED CMO No. 02 s. 2025
official_records_quezon_city_seed.csv.identifier: DepEd school IDs are official codes; the other rows are publication rows
